notes: Fixes "Colon AI keeps stopping" with Hey Colon on: the wake word engine is used by one thread at a time, Hey Colon opens full voice mode, and it keeps listening with battery saver on. If Colon ever stops, the next start switches Hey Colon off and shows a crash report you can copy.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.24.1 (no browser changes).
